Step 1: Separate sunk cost.
Sunk cost = $400,000.00 already spent, gone in both options, so exclude from forward-looking expected value from today.

Step 2: Expected value from today if stop.
Value_stop = sale value now = $60,000.00
Formula: Value_stop = 60000.00 = 60000.00

Step 3: Expected value from today if continue.
Cost to finish = $350,000.00
Success probability p = 0.30
Return if success = $1,200,000.00
Return if failure = $100,000.00

Expected gross return:
E_gross = p * Return_success + (1-p) * Return_failure
E_gross = 0.30 * 1200000.00 + (1-0.30) * 100000.00
E_gross = 0.30 * 1200000.00 + 0.70 * 100000.00
E_gross = 360000.00 + 70000.00 = 430000.00

Expected net from today:
Value_continue = E_gross - Cost_to_finish
Value_continue = 430000.00 - 350000.00 = 80000.00

Step 4: Recompute and compare.
Independently: 0.30*1200000.00 = 360000.00; 0.70*100000.00 = 70000.00; sum = 430000.00; minus 350000.00 = 80000.00.
Value_continue = $80,000.00 vs Value_stop = $60,000.00.
80,000.00 > 60,000.00, so maximize expected value by continue.

choice = continue; value = 80000
{"choice": "continue", "value": 80000}
